figures.label: S14
figures.caption: Figure S14. X-ray diffractograms of Li6PS5Cl, Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5, Li6PS5Br, Li6PS5I, and Li10GeP2S12 acquired after conducting laser-flash analysis measurements. No significant degradations occur during the measurements and sample transfer. The lithium argyrodites, i.e., Li6PS5Cl, Li6PS5Br, Li6PS5I, Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5, crystallize in the cubic 𝐹4ത3𝑚 space group that is characterized by a rigid substructure of PS43-- tetrahedra and a complex, partially occupied lithium ion substructure (Figure S15a). In this substructure, lithium ions are distributed across various lattice sites forming interlinked cages that result in a three-dimensional diffusion path for lithium ions.18,34 Due to the similar ionic radii of Cl- (181 pm), Br- (196 pm), and S2- (184 pm) a significant degree of anion disorder is present in the respective argyrodites. In contrast, no disorder is present in Li6PS5I.18,34,35 Refine
